section: Iterate — change: shadow proposals WebUI campaign brief
title: Scope the proposal-review window as a four-unit campaign
context: Leads in shadow mode will write proposals. The daemon header form differs from the one the WebUI parses, and the window has no reject, edit or audit record.
decision: Record a four-unit brief: one entry format in both repos, structured entry view, reject with audit record, edit before approving. No black-out and no parking.
consequences: Nothing is built yet. The brief fixes the rollout order across repositories and requires a test that no quote reaches the decisions log.
rationale: What matters is that quoted chat text does not enter the learnings; editing the line in the operator's own words does that without a redaction feature.
rejected: A black-out feature and a parking state: more states and format changes without a case that needs them yet.
